title: scikit-learn user guide and common pitfalls
note: Fit transformations only on training folds. Keep test labels out of selection. Use independent evaluation, appropriate split units and task-specific metrics. Regularization trades training fit against generalization. Calibration concerns probabilities, not only ranking.
provenance: Reference only; independently authored questions, no copied exercises.

title: Google Machine Learning Crash Course
note: Precision is TP/(TP+FP); recall is TP/(TP+FN). Class imbalance can make accuracy misleading. Decision thresholds trade false positives against false negatives. Gradient descent subtracts learning-rate-scaled gradients. Embeddings encode learned representations.
provenance: Reference only; independently authored questions, no copied exercises.

title: PyTorch automatic differentiation
note: Autograd differentiates recorded operations. Gradients accumulate unless cleared. Detaching a tensor breaks gradient tracking through that tensor. Training and evaluation modes affect modules such as dropout. Evaluation mode and disabling gradients are separate decisions.
provenance: Reference only; independently authored questions, no copied exercises.

title: Python data structures
note: Lists are mutable; tuples are immutable containers that can contain mutable objects. Dictionaries map unique hashable keys to values. Sets remove duplicates. A queue needs efficient removal from the front; a list is not always the appropriate queue representation.
provenance: Reference only; independently authored questions, no copied exercises.

title: PostgreSQL transaction isolation
note: Isolation levels control anomalies visible between concurrent transactions. PostgreSQL Read Committed uses statement-level snapshots. Serializable transactions can fail and require retry of the transaction. A transaction boundary alone does not establish serializable execution.
provenance: Reference only; independently authored questions, no copied exercises.

title: JavaScript execution model
note: Execution uses a call stack and queued jobs. Long synchronous work delays other jobs. Closures retain access to lexical environments. Asynchronous scheduling does not itself make CPU-bound work parallel.
provenance: Reference only; independently authored questions, no copied exercises.

title: Coding Interview University

title: RISC-V ISA specification
note: RV32I has 32-bit integer registers; x0 reads as zero. Loads and stores access memory. The base ISA distinguishes signed and unsigned comparisons and loads. ISA semantics and microarchitecture are different abstraction levels; pipelines and cache organizations are implementation decisions.
provenance: Reference only; independently authored questions, no copied exercises.

title: MIT Computation Structures
note: Digital systems compose combinational logic, state and timing constraints. Sequential correctness requires setup and hold constraints. Pipelining can improve throughput while increasing latency. Cache behavior depends on mapping, locality and access pattern. Metastability risk can be reduced but not completely eliminated.
provenance: Course topic reference; independently authored questions, no copied exercises.

title: HDLBits problem sets
note: Topic discovery: vectors, gates, multiplexers, arithmetic, sequential logic, finite state machines, counters and verification. Questions here are newly written; HDLBits exercises and solutions are not copied.

title: Yosys process synthesis
note: Synthesis converts process descriptions into combinational and sequential structures. Incomplete combinational assignments can infer storage. Simulation behavior, synthesis support and physical timing need separate checks.
provenance: Reference only; independently authored questions, no copied exercises.

title: Verilator warnings and diagnostics
note: Width, signedness, unused signals, multiple drivers and latch inference can indicate RTL defects. Lint findings require interpretation in design context. Simulation tests and lint do not establish analog timing or metastability safety.
provenance: Reference only; independently authored questions, no copied exercises.
